subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB979 (2026-09-22). Two contiguous delimiters: an alphabetic / alphanumeric / national receiver is space-filled by the MOVE of the zero-length conceptual item (14.9.25.4 GR1/GR2 substitute SPACE); a receiver DESCRIBED as numeric carries its own bound ZeroFill MOVE of ZERO (BoundUnstringReceiver.ZeroFill), taken when nothing was examined - the one place GR8 differs from the MOVE rules. Witnessed: N3 PIC 9(3) VALUE 999 -> 000 and A3 'YYY' -> spaces (85); a usage-national numeric receiver -> 000 (2002).
